posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Well. Looks like I was right. The next expansion is not standard format. Yay?

Honestly guys, and I love >G and SotM, I am not as excited for VotM as I was for WotC. The Vengeance format just doesn't see a whole lot of table time with my group. Coupled with 0 new hero decks, i'm lukewarm towards this. Will I get it? Sure I will. Theres going to be too much amazing art and story from a whopping 10 villains. 10! Good god. Side of the box looks like it has the blue deamon we see fighting Parse in Cap Cosmics deck btw.

Tactics: DARK WATCH ASSEMBLE! I was correct with my speculation here too! The images are small (Hey Christopher/Craig/Adam, can we get a larger image of the boxes to look over? Would that be impossible?) but you can clearly see Fixer, Setback, Expat, and....and....thats not Nightmist is it...someone new?

The expansion looks like a darker version of the Hippo, Heartbreaker, the mirror person from Slaughterhouse Six, and someone else, possibly from the Crackjaw crew. 

Larger images please!
